title: OpenAI Computing Chief to Depart
source_used: TradingView (Seeking Alpha) and BigGo Finance, both relaying the WSJ (WSJ blocked, HTTP 401)
key_facts: The Wall Street Journal reported that Sachin Katti, OpenAI's head of computing capacity, will leave next month after about a year in the role.
Katti is expected to stay on as an adviser; his final day is 15 Nov, per BigGo.
Uday Ruddarraju, a former xAI executive promoted this summer to chief technology officer of computing capacity, takes over computing strategy.
Katti joined in late 2025 and worked on the Stargate data center project, with deals involving SoftBank, Oracle and Amazon Web Services.
BigGo quotes a LinkedIn post in which Katti says he decided to 'move on to build something new'.
Another executive overseeing data center expansion left over the summer.
quote_evidence: head of computing capacity, Sachin Katti, will leave the AI company next month after about a year in the role, The Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday.
why_it_matters_hint: A change at the top of the team that builds OpenAI's very costly data center plans.
notes: WSJ original blocked. Two relays differ on OpenAI's compute spending plan ($750B vs $600B by 2030), so the figure was left out.
